pdfPages.title: Implementation architecture
pdfPages.subtitle: Flutter, Riverpod and Firebase boundaries
paragraphs: Flutter screens consume Riverpod providers/controllers. Service adapters isolate Firebase Auth, Firestore, AI Logic, Storage/PDF, FCM, Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config and App Check. GoRouter maps product routes; theme tokens stay centralized.
Catalog queries expose active tutors only. AI recommendations are validated against active catalog IDs. Network/configuration failures remain visible instead of fabricating tutors or recommendations.
Parent registration now reauthenticates matching credentials before retrying a missing profile. Existing parent/applicant profiles are not overwritten, and no existing identity is deleted.

Notification history uses per-UID v2 keys and requires matching data.recipientUid. Guests and unknown recipients receive no private inbox. Legacy global history is ignored; async preferences avoid stale isolate caches.
Known limits: 100-tutor search cap, undefined guest quota persistence, server chat-activity projection and nontransactional bounded local notification history.

pdfPages.title: Firebase security verification
pdfPages.subtitle: 26 real Firestore and Storage emulator tests pass
paragraphs: Tests run only against demo-beewise on local emulators. They cover private tutor applications, no self-approval/public tutor writes, parent profile/devices, active catalog, atomic connection/chat getAfter consistency, messages and responses.

Rules also cover invoices, payment-verification requests, verified schedule reads and Storage PDF reports. Positive and negative cases test owner/cross-user access, forbidden writes, malformed fields, expiry, stale proposal IDs and immutable trusted state.
A simultaneous parent+applicant batch is denied using post-write role checks. Applicants may detach their own stale device registration without gaining parent read/create rights.

Storage checks owner UID, .pdf extension, application/pdf metadata and size strictly below 10 MiB. Metadata validation is not proof that bytes form a genuine PDF. Production deployment and real bucket upload/download recovery remain unverified.
Firebase client config targets beewise-lab-3. Auth provider status, OAuth, App Check, FCM, AI terms, Analytics, Crashlytics, Remote Config and billing were not inspected or changed remotely.

pdfPages.title: Trusted backend contract
pdfPages.subtitle: Parent responses cannot create business outcomes
paragraphs: A trusted consultant proposal must exist in the same chat, with the correct kind/role, payload.status pending and a future payload.expiresAt Timestamp. The chat must reference its currentProposalId/currentRevisionId and eligible onboardingStatus.

Parent writes exactly one immutable responses/{proposalId}. Alternate time and adjustment reason must be nonempty and bounded. Client transactions give recovery errors; rules enforce the same boundary against malicious clients.
A trusted idempotent consumer must revalidate ownership, current proposal, expiry and state before processing. Admin SDK bypasses rules, so server-side tests and access control remain required.

Class confirmation may trigger server invoice issuance. A verification request is only pending intent. Real provider receipt, amount/currency and replay checks must precede verified payment and official schedule creation.
No staging endpoint, consultant service or payment backend exists in this repository. New required fields need staging fixture migration. See docs/backend-contract.md.
